strings.en: Daitarn 3...
Truly... it's Dai-daring.
Wasn't Daitarn 3 destroyed?
Omoikane, search data. Daitar...
Allow me to explain. That is definitely the real Daitarn 3.
This is only speculation, but the Daitarn blown up in the last war
was a fake, and the rumored Banjo Haran came to Mars for the real one.
"Rumored"...?
He's the son of Dr. Sozo Haran, who created the Meganoids.
Haran...! That's it, the key figure in developing Mars, the doctor
who made the Meganoids... his name was...!
Yo, job's done. With that much explosive planted, we're set.
Oh, Yamada, what were you up to?
Oh, I wanted to destroy the nearby Tulips just in case.
So I asked Yamada, since he looked bored.
It's Daigoji. Geez, here I was working where enemies
could pop up any second, and what were you all chatting about?
About Daitarn 3...
Whoa, why'd you talk about that while I wasn't here!?
Did you see it? Did ya? That size! That power! That's a super robot!
The size, sure, but that justice power suit squad made an impact too.
It was amazing, wasn't it? Making an entrance with a catchphrase,
and leaving with a catchphrase, like some mysterious helper.
And his partners being a suave swordsman and a wild drill guy,
that hits all the right notes!
Geez, I can't keep up with this.
Were those power suits, I wonder? They said they were flesh and blood...
Surely not...
Captain, enemy fleet movement detected.
They're closing in from nearly every direction in sensor range.
Nearly every direction... You mean we're surrounded!?
Yes. We're completely blockaded.
Damn... They wanna make this our graveyard!?
Were they waiting until the Nadesico was the only force around here!?
All hands, take your battle stations.
Megumi, contact the Mars Frontier Base!
About that... I can't get through... The signal should be reaching them...
but there's no response.
A desperate situation, with nowhere to run. That's about it...
There is somewhere to run...!
Somewhere to run? All that's near is a Tuli... Captain, you don't mean...!?
We'll send the Nadesico into the Tulip and Boson Jump!
Are you serious, Captain!? If you do that...
Enemy reinforcements confirmed. The gap in strength is widening.
Even the Nadesico and the Aestivalis team... can't fight those numbers...
So, the Tulip it is~
What are you saying!? It's reckless! All I can calculate is losses!
Ruri, order the Aestivalis units to return.
Minato, plot an entry angle into the Tulip, quick.
Captain, I can't permit that.
You are about to breach your contract with Nergal.
There must be some other way...
Can't you trust the crew you chose yourself!?
Entering the Tulip.
Is it really okay to go in there...?
What are you thinking!? Turn back right now!
Living things can't pass through, so the Jovian Lizards use Tulips
to send in unmanned machines, don't they!?
Not necessarily. We have a Distortion Field, so...
Send the detonation signal to the bombs set on the Tulips.
Then keep moving forward. Engines, prioritize field stability.
...What's going to happen to us...?
At last... we've come this far.
Abel... It seems rather noisy outside...?
Pay it no mind, Keim. Machines from that blue star...
that so-called Earth, seem to be prowling about the area...
Don't underestimate them, Abel. That one said... to conquer Earth,
we must strike this thing called Londo Bell...
Heh, Lord Diore, inferior beings need no tactics. Before the Dirad revive,
I believe it's vital to purge the Earth.
I beg you, order the whole army to sortie... Lord Diore.
Abel, Lord Diore has only just awoken from a 200-million-year slumber.
Lord Diore.
Abel! Our seed has finally found this land...
You know as well as I what happens if we fail now.
For now, as that one says, until we strike this Londo Bell,
I believe we shouldn't reveal our full strength.
Keim... You keep saying "that one," "that one," but he's...
He's... what...? Abel...
Hm...
Lord Shapiro...
Ow ow... Dammit, where are we!?
Looks like... we ended up way off the rendezvous point.
Is the Mazinger team okay!?
Probably... The Gaizok ship got knocked off course... They're fine.
Better worry about ourselves than about others. ...Look.
Gaizok mecha!? Why!?
Looks like they followed us. ...No battleship, though.
Guess they got swept over here same as us, huh?
Tch, no fun without a big shot, but let's smash 'em for now!
Let's do what we gotta first, Shinobu. ...There, distress signal's out.
Oh, nice thinking, Masato. Let's go!
Gil Berg... It seems things are not going well...
...Sir, my apologies... Grand Captain Garimos!
Next time... next time for certain...!
The Bunker needs no incompetents... You understand what that means...
...Sir.
At this rate... Gades's men might be more reliable... Gil Berg...
...!! Those people!? Grand Captain Garimos!
...I've acquired a pawn, one with ties to them.
Using that one, this time for sure...
The Cyber Beast Force has been found!?
It's a distress signal! Um, the location is... PLS Black Point...
Black Point? I've never heard of that sector.
A meteor swarm passed there lately. Probes have been sent a few times,
but apparently some kind of trouble always ends up damaging them...
Isn't something hiding out there? Sounds kinda fishy to me.
Speaking of fishy, we've also heard that one of the "Tulips"
is on the move, Captain.
Tulips... You mean the Jovian Lizards' transport carriers?
Yes. Slowly, but one of them appears to be approaching Earth...
Well, whatever's out there, we gotta go get the Cyber Beast Force
anyway, so what's the difference?
We'll end up heading there sooner or later anyway, right?
No use frettin' about it... Huh?
Somethin's showin' up on the radar, y'know?
Huh? This reading... Captain! It's mechs from the Bunker!
What!? Where!?
...Um... In the colony belt right near here!
Why would they be in a place like this!?
Let's sortie right away!
How hectic. Where should we go first, I wonder?
I want to go meet the Cyber Beast Force, but the derelict colonies
and that Tulip reading worry me too... All right, prepare to sortie!
Doctor! They say the Bunker's started moving...
Indeed. But, hmm... it doesn't look like they're aimin' for Earth.
What's that supposed to mean?
...Hmmm, this is... a trap, I'd say.
I think so too... It's probably Gil again...
Haaah, it's all such a drag, isn't it?
So, I've got a little proposal...
What is it, Doctor?
How about we just run off somewhere far away?
No matter how much we struggle against the Bunker...
Doctor, we're heading out.
I-I was only thinkin' of you kids, y'see...
Too bad, Doctor.
...Let's go.
Make up your mind already, old man.
...Oh, for goodness' sake...
